org.xces.graf.uima
Class TypePrioritiesFactory

java.lang.Object
  org.xces.graf.uima.TypePrioritiesFactory

public class TypePrioritiesFactory
extends Object

Used to generate a list of type priorities for the annotations in a graph.

There are two ways that type priorities may be determined:

First, by performing a depth-first traversal of the graph and noting the order in which annotations are encountered. For each annotation D the relation comes_before(A, D) is recorded for each ancestor A of D. For example, if the depth first traversal has reached node C via the path root -> A -> B -> C then the relations comesBefore(root, C), comesBefore(A, C), comesBefore(B, C) are recorded.

Second, based on the nature of the graph being processed, the user may want to specify an ordering amongst the annotations used. The user may want to do this when the graph contains multiple annotations per node or when many nodes point to the same region. In that case, the user must specify and exhaustive ordering (using an IAnnotationOrder object). The user can then use the getTypePriorities(IAnnotationOrder order) method in this class to retrieve the type priorities.

The package protected class PriorityComparator then uses these relations to reason about the ordering of a pair of annotations.
